error[ZBX-E0816]: the build file can't be written
  while  writing the build file
  cause  'zbx.build.zon' exists, and an import never replaces a file unasked
  path   zbx.build.zon
  fix    replace it with --force, or write elsewhere with -o:   zbx import -o imported.build.zon
  more   zbx explain E0816
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0816.html
